# Reflet

> Collect product feedback, plan work, and publish release notes.

Reflet has public feedback pages, an embeddable collector, support chat, surveys, status monitoring, and team tools for notes and voice sessions. Organizations control publication and access. Private session drafts are not visible to other members until shared.

## Authentication and discovery

Browser integrations use public keys. Administrative APIs require a secret key. Votes, comments, and subscriptions require server-signed user identity; an unsigned profile is not authentication. Reflet team access uses its own member login.

- [Authentication reference](https://www.reflet.app/auth.md)
- [Agent skills](https://www.reflet.app/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [API catalog](https://www.reflet.app/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Sitemap](https://www.reflet.app/sitemap.xml)
